# proxmox_node_ceph_restart (Resource)

Restarts one Ceph service through `POST /nodes/{node}/ceph/restart`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_restart" "r" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  service = "osd.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `service` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
